name: cloud.krova/mcp
description: Provision and manage Krova Cloud Cubes — Firecracker microVMs with root access and no public IP.

environmentVariables.name: KROVA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A Krova Cloud API key, created under Settings → API keys. Scoped to one Space and inherits the permissions of the membership that created it.

environmentVariables.name: KROVA_SPACE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional. A Space id the Cube tools default to, so a client does not have to name a Space on every call.

environmentVariables.name: KROVA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the API base URL. Only needed against a non-production environment.
